label: Frames and their invariants
subgoals: Set F_0 to the initial states
Maintain F_i inside F_(i+1) and F_i with T implying F_(i+1) in the next state
Ask whether the frontier frame can step to a not-P state

label: Blocking proof obligations
subgoals: Turn a frontier state with a bad successor into a proof obligation
Block it with a relatively inductive clause or recurse on its predecessor
Report a counterexample when an obligation chain reaches the initial states

label: Propagation and convergence
subgoals: Push each clause forward when the next frame still satisfies it
Detect two consecutive frames with identical clauses
Return the converged frame as an inductive invariant that implies P
